read.thesis: Q2 Adjusted EBITDA of $4.027bn beat prior year but payer-mix hit of ~$400m from exchange uninsured was offset by ~$400m Florida supplemental payment; FY26 EBITDA guide trimmed to $15.4–16.1bn from $15.55–16.45bn.

capex.quote: The Company's 2026 estimate for capital expenditures of $5.0 billion to $5.5 billion, excluding acquisitions, remains unchanged.

triggers.label: Medicaid supplemental $300–500m vs ($50)–($250)m
triggers.quote: Medicaid Supplemental Payment Programs ($50) to ($250) million $300 to $500 million

triggers.label: Surgical volumes declining
triggers.quote: Same facility inpatient surgeries declined 2.3 percent, and same facility outpatient surgeries declined 3.4 percent

guidance.quote: The Company's 2026 estimate for capital expenditures of $5.0 billion to $5.5 billion, excluding acquisitions, remains unchanged.

red_flags.label: Exchange payer-mix hit grew; Q1 estimate raised $75m
red_flags.quote: This amount includes an increase of approximately $75 million related to the Company’s previous estimate of the first quarter health insurance exchange impact.

red_flags.label: Q2 EBITDA lifted by one-off Florida supplemental benefit
red_flags.quote: the Company recognized approximately $400 million of incremental net benefit from Medicaid Supplemental Payment Programs, primarily related to the state of Florida
